properties.nhcTitle: East of the Leeward Islands (Remnants of Dolly)
properties.discussion:
Showers and thunderstorms have increased this morning in  association with the remnants of Tropical Storm Dolly, located  several hundred miles east of the Leeward Islands. However, there  are no signs that the system is developing a closed circulation. Redevelopment of this system is unlikely while it moves westward to  west-northwestward near 25 mph.  The wave could bring locally heavy  rains and gusty winds to portions of the Leeward Islands, the Virgin  Islands and Puerto Rico over the next several days. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...near 0 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...low...10 percent.

properties.nhcTitle: Northeastern and North-Central Gulf of America
properties.discussion:
Disorganized cloudiness and showers over portions of the  northeastern and north-central Gulf of America are associated with a  weak area of low pressure centered about 100 miles south-southwest  of Pensacola, Florida.  Development, if any, of this system is  expected to be slow while it drifts westward for the next few days. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...near 0 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...low...10 percent.

An area of disturbed weather, associated with a tropical wave, is  located well to the south of southwestern Mexico. Environmental  conditions appear favorable for gradual development of this system,  and a tropical depression is likely to form in the next several of  days while it moves west-northwestward to northwestward at 10 to 15  mph.  
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...40 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...90 percent.

An area of low pressure could form well south or southwest of the  Hawaiian Islands in the next few days. Some gradual development is  possible thereafter and a tropical depression could form during the  middle part of next week while the system moves slowly  west-northwestward, well offshore of the Hawaiian Islands. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...near 0 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...medium...40 percent.
